project_type: Full-stack: React frontend (Vite/pnpm) + FastAPI Python backend + Cloudflare Workers edge
build_system: pnpm (monorepo), pip for backend, wrangler for edge. Frontend builds via `pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build`
build_command: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build (requires VITE_BACKEND_URL env var)
verification_instructions: 1. Run frontend tests: cd apps/frontend && pnpm test. 2. Run backend tests: cd apps/backend && pytest --tb=short -q. 3. Verify frontend builds: cd apps/frontend && pnpm run build:client (with VITE_BACKEND_URL=https://api.syrabit.ai).
setup_instructions: 1. corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate. 2. pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile. 3. pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt (strip hashes if needed).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node 22, Python 3.11+.
contribution_requirements: Backend routes are at /api/v1/... prefix. All frontend API calls must use the correct path. Keep Turnstile integration. Keep token blacklisting and rate limiting from PR #184.
key_patterns: Frontend: React context pattern (AuthContext.jsx provides auth state). API calls use axios with API_BASE prefix. Backend: FastAPI with Beanie ODM for MongoDB. JWT tokens (access + refresh). Admin auth uses httpOnly cookies (syrabit_admin_session). Edge: Cloudflare Worker proxies /api/ to Azure backend.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/frontend (React+Vite), apps/backend (FastAPI), apps/edge (CF Worker). Backend routes at /api/v1/{auth,users,admin,chat,...}. Frontend API_BASE = ${VITE_BACKEND_URL}/api. All admin/auth API calls MUST include /v1 in path to reach backend.
